overview_description.description:
Activepieces is an open source business automation software that allows users to automate their work without writing code while keeping their data on their workstation. Users can create automations that send email and Slack notifications when new contacts are added to their HubSpot CRM.

Activepieces is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2022.
